title: Nosferatu
overview: Count Orlok, a vampire from Transylvania, preys on a young couple in this landmark of German Expressionist cinema. The unauthorized adaptation of Bram Stoker's Dracula remains one of the most influential horror films ever made.
attribution: Film is in the public domain due to copyright expiration (1922, US).

title: The General
overview: When Union spies steal an engineer's beloved locomotive, he pursues it single-handedly and straight through enemy lines. Buster Keaton's masterpiece combines breathtaking stunts with Civil War-era comedy.

title: A Trip to the Moon
overview: A group of astronomers travel to the Moon in a cannon-propelled capsule in this pioneering science fiction film. Georges Méliès's iconic image of the rocket landing in the Moon's eye remains one of cinema's most recognizable shots.
attribution: Film is in the public domain worldwide (1902).

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
overview: A mysterious hypnotist uses a somnambulist to commit murders at a carnival in this foundational German Expressionist film. Its distorted sets and shocking twist ending influenced decades of horror and film noir.
attribution: Film is in the public domain in the United States (1920).

title: Metropolis
overview: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working-class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior. Fritz Lang's epic vision of the future remains a touchstone for science fiction cinema.
attribution: Film is in the public domain in the United States (1927). Some restored versions may have separate rights.
